title: Huanghua port, Cangzhou VTS (黄骅港, 沧州VTS)
authority: Hebei MSA, Cangzhou MSA (沧州海事局), Cangzhou VTS centre (沧州VTS中心)
applies_to: Ships in Huanghua port waters, anchorages and waiting areas (no published VTS rules found).
applies_quote: 船舶在待泊期间应保持VHF08和16频道守听……船舶在待泊期间如发生紧急情况，应立即向沧州VTS 中心报告。（冀航通〔2025〕0269号）

when.text: In the coal port area temporary waiting areas: keep watch on VHF08 and 16 while waiting; in an emergency report at once to Cangzhou VTS centre; obey the VTS centre's traffic organisation. (冀航通〔2025〕0269号, 五.3, 5, 6; notice valid 2025-09-05 to 2026-03-04)

Keep watch on the set VHF channel, report the ship's movements on time and keep in contact with other ships and the VTS centre; follow routeing and reporting rules. Report danger at once to the MSA. (沧州海事局 安全航行建议 第2号, 2026, advice)

how.note: watch channel given for the coal port waiting areas (2025 notice, now expired); likely the VTS working channel, not confirmed for the whole port

ports: Huanghua (黄骅港): coal port area, comprehensive port area, Hebei

sources.title: 关于启用黄骅港煤炭港区临时待泊区的通告 冀航通〔2025〕0269号
关于公布使用新选划黄骅港2#锚地的通告 冀航通﹝2025﹞0128号
sources.ref: anchorage A to E; obey VTS centre

sources.title: 沧州海事局关于发布进出黄骅港船舶安全航行建议的通告（第2号）

verification: Channels and VTS name from an official msa.gov.cn notice (temporary waiting areas, 2025). No Huanghua / Cangzhou VTS rules, area or report lines found on msa.gov.cn or hb.msa.gov.cn.
notes: GAP: no published Cangzhou VTS rules, area, report lines, call sign or phone. VHF08 comes from a notice that ran to 2026-03-04; confirm the working channel with the agent. Huanghua 2# anchorage (since 2025-05-15) is a non-dangerous-goods anchorage for bulk carriers; 4# anchorage was cancelled (冀航通〔2025〕0407号). Cangzhou MSA advises masters new to the port (oil tankers 30,000 t and over, Chinese flag) to take a pilot because of the very long dredged channel.
